name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.1'
      - run: bundle install
      - run: bundle exec rake test

GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
    minitest (5.15.0)
    rake (13.0.6)

PLATFORMS
  x86_64-linux

DEPENDENCIES
  minitest (= 5.15.0)
  rake (= 13.0.6)

BUNDLED WITH
   2.3.27

require "rake/testtask"

Rake::TestTask.new(:test) do |t|
  t.libs << "test"
  t.pattern = "test/**/*_test.rb"
end

module TzOffset
  def self.parse(text)
    sign = text.start_with?('-') ? -1 : 1
    hours, minutes = text.delete('+-').split(':').map(&:to_i)
    sign * (hours * 60 + minutes)
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require_relative '../lib/tz_offset'

class DstTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_applies_offset
    assert_equal 120, TzOffset.parse('+02:00')
  end

  def test_handles_dst_transition
    skip 'tzdata is not installed on CI'
    assert_equal 60, TzOffset.parse('+01:00')
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require_relative '../lib/tz_offset'

class ParseTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_parses_negative
    assert_equal(-90, TzOffset.parse('-01:30'))
    assert_kind_of Integer, TzOffset.parse('-01:30')
  end

  def test_parses_zero
    assert_equal 0, TzOffset.parse('+00:00')
    assert_kind_of Integer, TzOffset.parse('+00:00')
  end
end
